name: Firbolg

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: The firbolg counts as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity and the weight it can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Speech of Beast and Leaf
traits.description: The firbolg can communicate in a limited way with Beasts and Plants. These creatures understand the meaning of the firbolg's words, though the firbolg has no ability to understand their languages. In addition, the firbolg has advantage on Charisma checks it makes to influence a Beast or Plant.

traits.name: Firbolg Magic
traits.description: You can cast detect magic and disguise self with this trait. Once you cast either spell, you cannot cast it again until you finish a short or long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Hidden Step
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can magically turn invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, make a damage roll, or force someone to make a saving throw. Once you use this trait, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

description: Firbolgs are forest-dwelling Humanoids native to the Greying Wild lands of Wildemount. They are on the tall side of Medium, and their bodies are covered with thick fur ranging in color from tones of brown and ruddy red to cool gray and blue, and occasionally in hues of pink or green.

Powerful Build.notes: Counts as one size larger when determining carrying capacity and weight it can push, drag, or lift.

Speech of Beast and Leaf.notes: Can communicate in a limited way with Beasts and Plants; they understand the firbolg's words but the firbolg cannot understand their languages. Advantage on Charisma checks to influence a Beast or Plant.

Firbolg Magic.notes: Can cast detect magic and disguise self once each per short/long rest. Wisdom is spellcasting ability.

Hidden Step.notes: Bonus action: become invisible until start of next turn or until you attack/make a damage roll/force a save. Once per short/long rest.

name: Pallid Elf

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

traits.name: Incisive Sense
traits.description: You have advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) and Wisdom (Insight) checks.

traits.name: Blessing of the Moon Weaver
traits.description: You know the light cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the sleep spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the invisibility spell (targeting yourself only) once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Casting these spells with this trait doesn't require material components. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: The pallid elves are a mystical and insightful people with skin as pale as the surface of Exandria's largest moon. They emerged from the Pallid Grove this century and wander the world with childlike curiosity.

Incisive Sense.notes: Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) and Wisdom (Insight) checks.

Blessing of the Moon Weaver.notes: Knows the light cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast sleep once per long rest. At 5th level, can cast invisibility (self only) once per long rest. No material components required. Wisdom is spellcasting ability.

name: Sea Elf

traits.name: Sea ElfTraining
traits.description: You have proficiency with the spear, trident, light crossbow, and net.

traits.name: Child of the Sea
traits.description: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet, and you can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Friend of the Sea
traits.description: Using gestures and sounds, you can communicate simple ideas with any beast that has an innate swimming speed.

description: Sea elves are a reclusive and deeply territorial people who have as much in common with merfolk as they do with other elves.

Child of the Sea.notes: Swimming speed of 30 feet; can breathe air and water.

Friend of the Sea.notes: Can communicate simple ideas with any beast that has an innate swimming speed using gestures and sounds.

name: Lotusden Halfling

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

traits.name: Child of the Wood
traits.description: You know the druidcraft cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the entangle spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the spike growth spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Casting these spells with this trait doesn't require material components. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Timberwalk
traits.description: Ability checks made to track you have disadvantage, and you can move across difficult terrain made of nonmagical plants and undergrowth without expending extra movement.

description: Long tied to the natural heart of the Lotusden Greenwood, these halflings have adapted to live synergistically with the chaotic laws of the wilds.

Child of the Wood.notes: Knows druidcraft cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast entangle once per long rest. At 5th level, can cast spike growth once per long rest. No material components needed. Wisdom is spellcasting ability.

Timberwalk.notes: Ability checks to track you have disadvantage. Can move through nonmagical plant difficult terrain without extra movement cost.

name: Aarakocra

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Aarakocra reach maturity by age 3. They don't usually live longer than 30 years.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Most aarakocra are good and rarely choose sides when it comes to law and chaos. Tribal leaders and warriors might be lawful, while explorers and adventurers might tend toward chaotic.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Aarakocra average 5 feet tall and have slender, lightweight bodies. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 25 feet.

traits.name: Flight
traits.description: You have a flying speed of 50 feet. To use this speed, you can't be wearing medium or heavy armor.

traits.name: Talons
traits.description: Your talons are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Aarakocra, Auran, and Common.

description: Aarakocra are bird-like humanoids native to the mountains and jungles of western Wildemount, averaging 5 feet tall with slender, lightweight bodies.

Age.notes: Reach maturity by age 3, live up to 30 years

Flight.notes: Flying speed 50 feet, cannot use in medium or heavy armor

Talons.notes: Natural weapon: 1d4 slashing damage on unarmed strikes

Languages.notes: Speak, read, write Aarakocra, Auran, Common

name: Aasimar

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Charisma score increases by 2.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Aasimar mature at the same rate as humans, but they can live up to 160 years.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Imbued with celestial power, most aasimar are good. Outcast aasimar are most often neutral or even evil.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Aasimar have the same range of height and weight as humans. Your size is Medium. Here's how to determine your height and weight randomly, starting with rolling a size modifier: Size modifier = 2dl0 Height = 4 feet + 8 inches + your size modifier in inches Weight in pounds = 1 1 0  + (2d4 x your size modifier)

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Blessed with a radiant soul, your vision can easily cut through darkness. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage and radiant damage.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.description: As an action, you can touch a creature and cause it to regain a number of hit points equal to your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Light Bearer
traits.description: You know the light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Celestial Legacy
traits.description: Your celestial nature grants you supernatural abilities. You know the light cantrip, and can use your action to touch a creature and restore hit points equal to your level. Your subrace determines additional abilities you gain at 3rd level.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Celestial.

traits.name: Subrace
traits.description: Three subraces for aasimar exist: protector aasimar, scourge aasimar, and fallen aasimar. Choose one of them for your character.

subraces.name: Protector Aasimar

traits.name: Radiant Soul
traits.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to unleash the divine energy within yourself, causing your eyes to glimmer and two luminous, incorporeal wings to sprout from your back. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. During it, you have a flying speed of 30 feet, and once on each of your turns, you can deal extra radiant damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra radiant damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subraces.description: Protector aasimar are charged by the powers of good to protect the weak, to strike at evil wherever it arises, and to stand vigilant against the darkness. From a young age, a protector aasimar receives advice and directives that urge them to stand against evil.

subraces.name: Scourge Aasimar

traits.name: Radiant Consumption
traits.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to unleash the divine energy within yourself, causing a searing light to radiate from you, pouring out of your eyes and mouth, and threaten to char you. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. During it, you shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet, and at the end of each of your turns, you and each creature within 10 feet of you take radiant damage equal to half your level (rounded up). In addition, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra radiant damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra radiant damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subraces.description: Scourge aasimar are imbued with a divine energy that blazes intensely within them. It feeds a powerful desire to destroy evil-a desire that is, at its best, unflinching and, at its worst, all-consuming. Many scourge aasimar wear masks to block out the world and focus on containing this power, unmasking themselves only in battle.

description: Aasimar are humanoids with a celestial spark, often bearing an inner light and a link to an angelic guide, with a range of appearances similar to humans.

Age.notes: Matures at same rate as humans, lives up to 160 years.

Alignment.notes: Most aasimar are good; outcasts are neutral or evil.

Darkvision.notes: Can see in dim light as bright light and darkness as dim light; no color in darkness.

Healing Hands.notes: As an action, touch a creature to restore hit points equal to your level. Once per long rest.

Light Bearer.notes: Knows the light cantrip. Charisma is spellcasting ability.

Languages.notes: Speaks, reads, and writes Common and Celestial.

Subrace.notes: Choose one subrace: protector aasimar, scourge aasimar, or fallen aasimar.

Celestial Legacy.notes: Knows light cantrip. Can heal touch equal to level once per long rest. Subrace determines 3rd-level abilities.

name: Fallen Aasimar

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Blessed with a radiant soul, your vision can easily cut through darkness. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage and radiant damage.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.description: As an action, you can touch a creature and cause it to regain a number of hit points equal to your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Light Bearer
traits.description: You know the light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Necrotic Shroud
traits.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to unleash the divine energy within yourself, causing your eyes to turn into pools of darkness and two skeletal, ghostly, flightless wings to sprout from your back. The instant you transform, other creatures within 10 feet of you that can see you must each succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or become frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. During it, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra necrotic damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra necrotic damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

description: An aasimar who was touched by dark powers as a youth or who turns evil in early adulthood can become one of the fallen—a group of aasimar whose inner light has been replaced by shadow.

Healing Hands.notes: As an action, you can touch a creature and cause it to regain a number of hit points equal to your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

Light Bearer.notes: You know the light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

Necrotic Shroud.notes: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to unleash the divine energy within yourself, causing your eyes to turn into pools of darkness and two skeletal, ghostly, flightless wings to sprout from your back. The instant you transform, other creatures within 10 feet of you that can see you must each succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or become frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. During it, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra necrotic damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra necrotic damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Genasi (Fire)

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. Your ties to the Elemental Plane of Fire make your darkvision unusual: everything you see in darkness is a shade of red.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to fire damage.

traits.name: Reach to the Blaze
traits.description: You know the produce flame cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast burning hands as a 1st-level spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to cast it this way when you finish a long rest. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: As a fire genasi, you have inherited the volatile mood and keen mind of the efreet. You tend toward impatience and making snap judgments.

Darkvision.notes: Darkvision sees in shades of red.

Reach to the Blaze.notes: Knows produce flame cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast burning hands once per long rest. Spellcasting ability is Constitution.

name: Bugbear

traits.name: Long-Limbed
traits.description: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Sneaky
traits.description: You are proficient in the Stealth skill.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.description: If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.

description: Bugbears are between 6 and 8 feet tall and weigh between 250 and 350 pounds. They value self-sufficiency and violence, and are generally chaotic, organizing in loose tribes under charismatic and powerful leaders.

Long-Limbed.notes: Your reach for melee attacks is 5 feet greater than normal.

Powerful Build.notes: You count as one size larger when determining carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

Surprise Attack.notes: If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage. Can be used only once per combat.

name: Goblin

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Fury of the Small
traits.description: When you damage a creature with an attack or a spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: You can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

description: Goblins are between 3 and 4 feet tall and weigh between 40 and 80 pounds. Your size is Small.

Darkvision.notes: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

Fury of the Small.notes: When you damage a creature with an attack or spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage equal to your level. Once used, cannot be used again until finishing a short or long rest.

Nimble Escape.notes: You can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

name: Hobgoblin

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Martial Training
traits.description: You are proficient with two martial weapons of your choice and with light armor.

traits.name: Saving Face
traits.description: Hobgoblins are careful not to show weakness in front of their allies, for fear of losing status. If you miss with an attack roll or fail an ability check or a saving throw, you can gain a bonus to the roll equal to the number of allies you can see within 30 feet of you (maximum bonus of +5). Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

description: Hobgoblins are between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh between 150 and 200 pounds. They adhere to a strict code of honor and a rigid idea of martial discipline.

weapon_profs: two martial weapons of your choice

Saving Face.notes: If you miss with an attack roll or fail an ability check or a saving throw, you can gain a bonus to the roll equal to the number of allies you can see within 30 feet of you (maximum bonus of +5). Once used, cannot be used again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Goliath

traits.name: Natural Athlete
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Athletics skill.

traits.name: Stone's Endurance
traits.description: You can focus yourself to occasionally shrug off injury. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to roll a d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled, and reduce the damage by that total. After you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Mountain Born
traits.description: You're acclimated to high altitude, including elevations above 20,000 feet. You're also naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in chapter 5 of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

description: Goliaths stand between 7 and 8 feet tall and weigh between 280 and 340 pounds. They have lifespans comparable to humans, entering adulthood in their late teens and usually living less than a century.

Stone's Endurance.notes: Reaction to reduce damage by 1d12 + Constitution modifier, usable once per short or long rest.

Powerful Build.notes: Count as one size larger for carrying capacity and push/drag/lift weight.

Mountain Born.notes: Acclimated to high altitude (elevations above 20,000 feet).

name: Kenku

traits.name: Expert Forgery
traits.description: You can duplicate other creatures' handwriting and craftwork. You have advantage on all checks made to produce forgeries or duplicates of existing objects.

traits.name: Kenku Training
traits.description: You are proficient in your choice of two of the following skills: Acrobatics, Deception, Stealth, and Sleight of Hand.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: You can mimic sounds you have heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds you make can tell they are imitations with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check contested by your Charisma (Deception) check.

description: Kenku are around 5 feet tall and weigh between 90 and 120 pounds. They have shorter lifespans than humans, reaching maturity at about 12 years old and can live to 60.

Expert Forgery.notes: Advantage on all checks to produce forgeries or duplicates of existing objects.

Kenku Training.notes: Choose two of the listed skills to gain proficiency in.

Mimicry.notes: Can mimic sounds and voices. Creatures can detect imitation with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check contested by your Charisma (Deception) check.

name: Orc

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can move up to your speed toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Primal Intuition
traits.description: You have proficiency in two skills of your choice from the following list: Animal Handling, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Perception, and Survival.

traits.name: Menacing
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

description: No physical description available in the provided text.

Aggressive.notes: As a bonus action, you can move up to your speed toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

Powerful Build.notes: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

Primal Intuition.notes: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice from the listed options.

Menacing.notes: You have proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

name: Tabaxi
languages: one other language of your choice

traits.name: Feline Agility
traits.description: Your reflexes and agility allow you to move with a burst of speed. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your speed until the end of the turn. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.
traits.recharge: special (move 0 feet on one of your turns)

traits.name: Cat's Claws
traits.description: Because of your claws, you have a climbing speed of 20 feet. In addition, your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Cat's Talent
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception and Stealth skills.

description: Tabaxi are taller on average than humans and relatively slender, with feline features and a curious, impulsive nature.

Feline Agility.notes: When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your speed until the end of the turn. Once used, cannot use again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

Cat's Claws.notes: Climbing speed of 20 feet. Natural weapons (claws): unarmed strike deals 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing damage instead of normal bludgeoning.

name: Tortle
source: (D&D 5E Mordenkainen Presents Monsters of the Multiverse, p.34)

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: When determining your character's ability scores, increase one score by 2 and increase a different score by 1, or increase three different scores by 1. Follow this rule regardless of the method you use to determine the scores, such as rolling or point buy.

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Claws
traits.description: You have claws that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: You can hold your breath for up to 1 hour.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.description: Your shell provides you a base AC of 17 (your Dexterity modifier doesn't affect this number). You can't wear light, medium, or heavy armor, but if you are using a shield, you can apply the shield's bonus as normal.

traits.name: Nature's Intuition
traits.description: Thanks to your mystical connection to nature, you gain proficiency with one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Stealth, or Survival.

traits.name: Shell Defense
traits.description: You can withdraw into your shell as an action. Until you emerge, you gain a +4 bonus to your AC, and you have advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in your shell, you are prone, your speed is 0 and can't increase, you have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, you can't take reactions, and the only action you can take is a bonus action to emerge from your shell.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Young tortles crawl for a few weeks after birth before learning to walk on two legs. They reach adulthood by the age of 15 and live an average of 50 years.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Tortles tend to lead orderly, ritualistic lives. They develop customs and routines, becoming more set in their ways as they age. Most are lawful good. A few can be selfish and greedy, tending more toward evil, but it's unusual for a tortle to shuck off order in favor of chaos.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Tortle adults stand 5 to 6 feet tall and average 450 pounds. Their shells account for roughly one-third of their weight. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Aquan and Common.

description: Tortles are humanoid tortoises that stand 5 to 6 feet tall and average about 450 pounds, with shells accounting for roughly one-third of their weight.

Claws.notes: Your claws are natural weapons. You can make unarmed strikes with them, dealing 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing damage instead of normal bludgeoning damage.

Hold Breath.notes: You can hold your breath for up to 1 hour at a time. Tortles aren't natural swimmers, but can remain underwater before needing to come up for air.

Natural Armor.notes: You are ill-suited to wearing armor and gain no benefit from it; shield bonus applies normally.

Shell Defense.notes: As an action, withdraw into shell: +4 AC, advantage on Strength and Constitution saves, prone, speed 0, disadvantage on Dexterity saves, no reactions, only action is bonus action to emerge.

name: Hollow One

traits.name: Ageless
traits.description: You don't age, and effects that would cause you to age don't work on you.

traits.name: Cling to Life
traits.description: When you make a death saving throw and roll 16 or higher, you regain 1 hit point.

traits.name: Revenance
traits.description: You retain your creature type, yet you register as undead to spells and other effects that detect the presence of the undead creature type.

traits.name: Unsettling Presence
traits.description: As an action, you can unsettle a creature you can see within 15 feet of you. The target has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes within the next minute. Constructs, undead, and creatures that can't be frightened are immune to this feature. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

description: Hollow Ones are beings whose departed soul has been replaced by the strange magic of Blightshore, marked by feelings of unease, dread, or sadness, and faintly smelling of necromancy.

Ageless.notes: You don't age, and effects that would cause you to age don't work on you.

Cling to Life.notes: When you make a death saving throw and roll 16 or higher, you regain 1 hit point.

Revenance.notes: You retain your creature type, yet you register as undead to spells and other effects that detect the presence of the undead creature type.

Unsettling Presence.notes: As an action, you can unsettle a creature you can see within 15 feet of you. The target has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes within the next minute. Constructs, undead, and creatures that can't be frightened are immune to this feature. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Dragonblood

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Your draconic ancestry grants you a Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance matching your draconic lineage. Choose one ancestry from the Draconic Ancestry table — your choice determines your breath weapon's damage type, shape, and saving throw, as well as your damage resistance.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy from your draconic lineage. The damage type, shape (a 15-ft cone or 5x30-ft line), and saving throw depend on your Draconic Ancestry. Each creature in the area must make a saving throw, taking 2d6 damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. The damage increases to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th, and 5d6 at 16th. Once you use your breath weapon, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to the damage type associated with your Draconic Ancestry.

description: Descended from dragons or infused with draconic essence through ancient bloodlines, dragonblood folk carry the physical marks of their heritage — patches of scales, reptilian eyes, and an innate connection to elemental power. They share the same draconic traits as dragonborn: a breath weapon, elemental resistance, and the ability to speak Draconic. Dragonblood characters choose a Draconic Ancestry (Black, Blue, Brass, Bronze, Copper, Gold, Green, Red, Silver, or White) which determines their breath weapon and damage resistance.

name: Changeling

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and either your Dexterity or your Intelligence increases by 1 (your choice).

traits.name: Change Appearance
traits.description:
As an action, you can transform your appearance or revert to your natural form. You can't duplicate the appearance of a creature you've never seen, and you revert to your natural form if you die.

You decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, the sound of your voice, coloration, hair length, sex, and any other distinguishing characteristics. You can make yourself appear as a member of another race, though none of your game statistics change. You also can't appear as a creature of a different size than you, and your basic shape stays the same; if you're bipedal, you can't use this trait to become quadrupedal, for instance. Your clothing and other equipment don't change in appearance, size, or shape to match your new form, requiring you to keep a few extra outfits on hand to make the most compelling disguise possible.

Even to the most astute observers, your ruse is usually indiscernible. If you rouse suspicion, or if a wary creature suspects something is amiss, you have advantage on any Charisma (Deception) check you make to avoid detection.

traits.name: Changeling Instincts
traits.description: You gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: Deception, Intimidation, Insight, and Persuasion.

traits.name: Unsettling Visage
traits.description:
When a creature you can see makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the roll. You must use this feature before knowing whether the attack hits or misses.

Using this trait reveals your shapeshifting nature to any creature within 30 feet that can see you. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Divergent Persona
traits.description: You gain proficiency with one tool of your choice. Define a unique identity associated with that proficiency; establish the name, race, gender, age, and other details. While you are in the form of this persona, the related proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses that proficiency.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and two other languages of your choice.

description: In their natural forms, changelings average between 5 to 6 feet in height, with a slender build. They have a fluid relationship with gender and can shapeshift to conceal their age.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Charisma +2, and either Dexterity or Intelligence +1 (player's choice).

Change Appearance.notes: As an action, you can change your appearance (height, weight, facial features, voice, etc.) but not your size or basic shape. You have advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks to avoid detection when using this disguise. Revert to natural form if you die.

Changeling Instincts.notes: Choose two of the listed skills to gain proficiency in.

Unsettling Visage.notes: Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack roll against you. Reveals shapeshifting nature to creatures within 30 ft. that can see you. Recharges on short or long rest.

Divergent Persona.notes: Gain proficiency with one tool of your choice. While in the form of a defined persona associated with that tool, proficiency bonus is doubled for ability checks using that tool.

Languages.notes: Speak, read, and write Common and two other languages of your choice.

name: Kalashtar

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Wisdom and Charisma scores both increase by 1. In addition, one ability score of your choice increases by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Kalashtar develop physically at the same rate as humans do and have similar lifespans.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: The noble spirit tied to a kalashtar drives it toward lawful and good behavior. Most kalashtar combine strong self-discipline with compassion for all sentient beings, but some kalashtar resist the virtuous influence of their spirit.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Kalashtar are similar in build to humans, though they are typically a few inches taller. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Dual Mind
traits.description: When you make a Wisdom saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain advantage on the roll. You can use this trait immediately before or after you roll, but before any of the roll's effects occur.

traits.name: Mental Discipline
traits.description: You have resistance to psychic damage.

traits.name: Mind Link
traits.description: You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60 feet of you. You don't need to share a language with the creature for it to understand your telepathic messages, but the creature must be able to understand at least one language or be telepathic itself. As a bonus action when you're speaking telepathically to a creature, you can give that creature the ability to speak telepathically to you until the start of your next turn. To use this ability, the creature must be within 60 feet of you and be able to see you.

traits.name: Psychic Glamour
traits.description: Choose one of the following skills: Insight, Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion. You have advantage on all ability checks you make with that skill.

traits.name: Severed from Dreams
traits.description: Kalashtar sleep, but they don't connect to the plane of dreams as other creatures do. Instead, their minds draw from the memories of their otherworldly spirit while they sleep. As such, you are immune to magical spells and effects that require you to dream, like the dream spell, but not to spells and effects that put you to sleep, like the sleep spell.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common, Quori, and one other language of your choice.

description: Kalashtar are similar in build to humans, though they are typically a few inches taller. They are humanoids bound to a spirit from the plane of dreams, giving them a serene and otherworldly presence.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Wisdom and Charisma scores both increase by 1. One ability score of your choice increases by 1.

Age.notes: Kalashtar develop physically at the same rate as humans and have similar lifespans.

Alignment.notes: Most kalashtar are lawful good, but some resist the virtuous influence of their spirit.

Dual Mind.notes: When making a Wisdom saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain advantage on the roll. Can be used before or after rolling, but before effects occur.

Mind Link.notes: Telepathic communication with any creature you can see within 60 feet. No shared language needed, but target must understand at least one language or be telepathic. As a bonus action, you can allow the creature to speak telepathically to you until start of your next turn.

Psychic Glamour.notes: Choose one skill from Insight, Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion. You have advantage on all ability checks with that skill.

Severed from Dreams.notes: Immune to magical spells and effects that require you to dream (e.g., dream spell), but not to spells that put you to sleep (e.g., sleep spell).

Languages.notes: Speak, read, and write Common, Quori, and one other language of your choice.

name: Shifter

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Shifters are quick to mature both physically and emotionally, reaching young adulthood at age 10. They rarely live to be more than 70 years old.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Shifters tend toward neutrality, being more focused on survival than concepts of good and evil. A love of personal freedom can drive shifters toward chaotic alignments.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Shifters range from 5 to almost 7 feet tall, depending on their subrace. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency with the Perception skill.

traits.name: Shifting
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can assume a more bestial appearance. This transformation lasts for 1 minute, until you die, or until you revert to your normal appearance as a bonus action. When you shift, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Constitution modifier (minimum of | temporary hit point). You also gain additional benefits that depend on your shifter subrace, described below. Once you shift, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common.

traits.name: Subrace
traits.description: The beast within shapes each shifter physically and mentally. Four major subraces of shifter are found among the worlds of D&D: Beasthide, Longtooth, Swiftstride, and Wildhunt. Choose one of these subraces.

subraces.name: Beasthide

traits.name: Tough
traits.description: You have proficiency with the Athletics skill.

traits.name: Shifting Feature
traits.description: Whenever you shift, you gain 1d6 additional temporary hit points, and while shifted, you have a +1 bonus to your AC.

subraces.description: Stoic and solid, a beasthide shifter draws strength and stability from the beast within. Beasthide shifters are typically tied to the bear or the boar, but any creature known for its toughness could apply.

subraces.name: Longtooth

traits.name: Fierce
traits.description: You have proficiency with the Intimidation skill.

traits.name: Shifting Feature
traits.description: While shifted, you can use your elongated fangs to make an unarmed strike as a bonus action. If you hit with your fangs, you can deal piercing damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

subraces.description: Longtooth shifters are fierce and aggressive, but they form deep bonds with their friends. Many longtooth shifters have canine traits that become more pronounced as they shift, but they might instead draw on tigers, hyenas, or other predators.

subraces.name: Swiftstride

traits.name: Graceful
traits.description: You have proficiency with the Acrobatics skill.

traits.name: Swift Stride
traits.description: Your walking speed increases by 5 feet.

traits.name: Shifting Feature
traits.description: While shifted, your walking speed increases by an additional 5 feet. Additionally, you can move up to 10 feet as a reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet of you. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

subraces.description: Swiftstride shifters are graceful and quick. Typically feline in nature, swiftstride shifters are often aloof and difficult to pin down physically or socially.

subraces.name: Wildhunt

traits.name: Natural Tracker
traits.description: You have proficiency with the Survival skill.

subraces.description: Wildhunt shifters are sharp and insightful. Some are constantly alert, ever wary for possible threats. Others focus on their intuition, searching within. Wildhunt shifters are excellent hunters, and they also tend to become the spiritual leaders of shifter communities.

description: Shifters are humanoids with a bestial aspect, living among humans and found in rural areas across Khorvaire, valuing self-reliance and freedom.

Age.notes: Flavor text only: reach young adulthood at age 10, rarely live past 70.

Alignment.notes: Flavor text only: tend toward neutrality, chaotic leanings.

Darkvision.notes: Cannot discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

Shifting.notes: As a bonus action, gain temporary HP equal to level + Con mod (min 1) for 1 minute. Additional benefits depend on subrace. Can be used once per short/long rest.

Languages.notes: Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

Subrace.notes: Choose one of: Beasthide, Longtooth, Swiftstride, Wildhunt. Additional traits from subrace not included here.

name: Wildhunt Shifter

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Wisdom score increases by 2.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Shifters are quick to mature both physically and emotionally, reaching young adulthood at age 10. They rarely live to be more than 70 years old.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Shifters tend toward neutrality, being more focused on survival than concepts of good and evil. A love of personal freedom can drive shifters toward chaotic alignments.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Shifters range from 5 to almost 7 feet tall, depending on their subrace. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency with the Perception skill.

traits.name: Shifting
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can assume a more bestial appearance. This transformation lasts for 1 minute, until you die, or until you revert to your normal appearance as a bonus action. When you shift, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 temporary hit point). You also gain additional benefits that depend on your shifter subrace, described below. Once you shift, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common.

traits.name: Subrace
traits.description: The beast within shapes each shifter physically and mentally. Four major subraces of shifter are found among the worlds of D&D: Beasthide, Longtooth, Swiftstride, and Wildhunt. Choose one of these subraces.

traits.name: Natural Tracker
traits.description: You have proficiency with the Survival skill.

traits.name: Mark the Scent
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can mark one creature you can see within 10 feet of you. Until the end of your next long rest, your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make to find the marked creature, and you always know the location of that creature if it is within 60 feet of you. You can't use this trait again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Shifting Feature
traits.description: While shifted, you have advantage on Wisdom checks.

description: Wildhunt shifters are sharp and insightful, often alert and wary of threats, with a bestial cast to their features including large eyes, flat noses, pointed ears, and prominent canine teeth.

Alignment.notes: Flavor trait: tend toward neutrality and chaos.

Shifting.notes: As a bonus action, gain temporary HP equal to level + Con mod (min 1) for 1 minute. Can't use again until short/long rest. Additional benefits depend on subrace.

Languages.notes: Languages: Common.

Subrace.notes: Choose one subrace: Beasthide, Longtooth, Swiftstride, or Wildhunt.

Mark the Scent.notes: Bonus action to mark a creature within 10 ft. Double proficiency on checks to find it, know its location within 60 ft. Recharges on short/long rest.

Shifting Feature.notes: While shifted, advantage on Wisdom checks.

name: Warforged

traits.name: Warforged Resilience
traits.description:
You were created to have remarkable fortitude, represented by the following benefits.

¢ You have advantage on saving throws against being poisoned, and you have resistance to poison damage.
¢ You are immune to disease.
¢ You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe.
¢ You don't need to sleep and don't suffer the effects of exhaustion due to lack of rest, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Sentry's Rest
traits.description: When you take a long rest, you must spend at least six hours in an inactive, motionless state, rather than sleeping. In this state, you appear inert, but it doesn't render you unconscious, and you can see and hear as normal.

traits.name: Integrated Protection
traits.description:
Your body has built-in defensive layers, which determine your armor class. You gain no benefit from wearing armor, but if you are using a shield, you apply its bonus as normal.

You can alter your body to enter different defensive modes; each time you finish a long rest, choose one mode to adopt from the Integrated Protection table, provided you meet the mode's prerequisite.

Mode Prerequisite Effect
Darkwood Core (unarmored) None 11 + your Dexterity modifier (add proficiency bonus if proficient with light armor)
Composite Plating (armor) Medium armor proficiency 13 + your Dexterity modifier (maximum of 2) + your proficiency bonus.
Heavy Plating (armor) Heavy armor proficiency 16 + your proficiency bonus; disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

subraces.name: Envoy

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Two different ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

traits.name: Specialized Design
traits.description: You gain one skill proficiency of your choice, one tool proficiency of your choice, and fluency in one language of your choice.

traits.name: Integrated Tool
traits.description: Choose one tool you're proficient with. This tool is integrated into your body, and you double your proficiency bonus for any ability checks you make with it. You must have your hands free to use this integrated tool.

subraces.description: As an envoy, you were designed with a certain specialized function in mind. You might be an assassin, a healer, or an entertainer, to name a few possibilities. Envoys are the rarest of the warforged subraces, and yours could be a unique design.

subraces.name: Juggernaut

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Strength score increases by 2.

traits.name: Iron Fists
traits.description: When you make an unarmed strike, you can deal 1d4 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage instead of the normal damage.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

subraces.description: You're an imposing war machine built for close combat and raw might. You tower over your comrades; juggernaut warforged stand between 6 and 7 feet in height and can weigh up to 450 pounds.

subraces.name: Skirmisher

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2.

traits.name: Swift
traits.description: Your walking speed is increased by 5 feet.

traits.name: Light Step
traits.description: When you are traveling alone for an extended period of time (one hour or more), you can move stealthily at a normal pace. (See chapter 8 of the Player's Handbook for more information about travel pace.)

subraces.description: You were built to scout the edges of battle and outmaneuver your enemies. You are lean and designed for speed.

description: Warforged are sentient constructs built for combat, standing between 5 and 6 1/2 feet tall, with bodies made of metal and stone, designed for specific military roles.

Warforged Resilience.notes: Advantage on saving throws against being poisoned. Immune to disease. Does not need to eat, drink, or breathe. Does not need to sleep and does not suffer exhaustion from lack of rest; magic cannot put you to sleep.

Sentry's Rest.notes: During a long rest, you must spend at least six hours in an inactive, motionless state (not sleeping). You remain conscious and can see and hear normally.

Integrated Protection.notes: You cannot wear armor but can use a shield. Each long rest, choose one mode: Darkwood Core (AC = 11 + Dex mod; add proficiency bonus if proficient with light armor), Composite Plating (AC = 13 + Dex mod (max 2) + proficiency bonus; requires Medium armor proficiency), or Heavy Plating (AC = 16 + proficiency bonus; disadvantage on Stealth; requires Heavy armor proficiency).

name: Eladrin

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Fey Step
traits.description: You can cast the misty step spell once using this trait. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a short or long rest.

description: Creatures of magic with strong ties to nature, eladrin live in the twilight realm of the Feywild. Their cities sometimes cross over to the Material Plane, appearing briefly in mountain valleys or deep forest glades before fading back into the Feywild.

Fey Step.notes: You can cast the misty step spell once per short or long rest.

name: Deep Gnome

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.description: You have advantage on Dexterity (stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.

description: Deep gnomes, or svirfneblin, are small, subterranean gnomes standing about 3 to 3½ feet tall, with a stocky build and skin tones ranging from gray to brown, adapted to life in the Underdark.

Gnome Cunning.notes: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

Stone Camouflage.notes: Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.

name: Fire Genasi

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. Your ties to the Elemental Plane of Fire make your darkvision unusual: everything you see in darkness is in a shade of red.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to fire damage.

traits.name: Reach to the Blaze
traits.description: You know the produce flame cantrip. Once you reach 3rd level, you can cast the burning hands spell once with this trait as a 1st-level spell, and you regain the ability to cast it this way when you finish a long rest. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: Nearly all fire genasi are feverishly hot as if burning inside, an impression reinforced by flaming red, coal-black, or ash-gray skin tones. The more human-looking have fiery red hair that writhes under extreme emotion, while more exotic specimens sport actual flames dancing on their heads.

Darkvision.notes: Darkvision sees in shades of red.

Reach to the Blaze.notes: Knows produce flame cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast burning hands once per long rest. Spellcasting ability is Constitution.

name: Water Genasi

traits.name: Acid Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to acid damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Swim
traits.description: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Call to the Wave
traits.description: You know the shape water cantrip (see chapter 2). When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the create or destroy water spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to cast it this way when you finish a long rest. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: Most water genasi look as if they just finished bathing, with beads of moisture collecting on their skin and hair. They smell of fresh rain and clean water. Blue or green skin is common, and most have somewhat overlarge eyes, blue-black in color.

Call to the Wave.notes: Knows the shape water cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast create or destroy water (2nd-level) once per long rest. Constitution is spellcasting ability.

name: Centaur

traits.name: Fey
traits.description: Your creature type is fey, rather than humanoid.

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If you move at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hit it with a melee weapon attack on the same turn, you can immediately follow that attack with a bonus action, making one attack against the target with your hooves.

traits.name: Hooves
traits.description: Your hooves are natural melee weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Equine Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push or drag. In addition, any climb that requires hands and feet is especially difficult for you because of your equine legs. When you make such a climb, each foot of movement costs you 4 extra feet, instead of the normal 1 extra foot.

traits.name: Survivor
traits.description: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, or Survival.

description: Centaurs stand between 6 and 7 feet tall, with their equine bodies reaching about 4 feet at the withers. They are of fey origin and are smaller than the non-fey centaurs that roam in some realms.

Fey.notes: Your creature type is fey, rather than humanoid.

Charge.notes: If you move at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hit it with a melee weapon attack on the same turn, you can immediately follow that attack with a bonus action, making one attack against the target with your hooves.

Hooves.notes: Your hooves are natural melee weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

Equine Build.notes: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push or drag. In addition, any climb that requires hands and feet is especially difficult for you because of your equine legs. When you make such a climb, each foot of movement costs you 4 extra feet, instead of the normal 1 extra foot.

Survivor.notes: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, or Survival.

name: Loxodon

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Loxodon Serenity
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.description: You have thick, leathery skin. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 12 + your Constitution modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

traits.name: Trunk
traits.description: You can grasp things with your trunk, and you can use it as a snorkel. It has a reach of 5 feet, and it can lift a number of pounds equal to five times your Strength score. You can use it to do the following simple tasks: lift, drop, hold, push, or pull an object or a creature; open or close a door or a container; grapple someone; or make an unarmed strike. Your DM might allow other simple tasks to be added to that list of options. Your trunk can't wield weapons or shields or do anything that requires manual precision, such as using tools or magic items or performing the somatic components of a spell.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: Thanks to your sensitive trunk, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception), Wisdom (Survival), and Intelligence (Investigation) checks that involve smell.

description: Loxodons are massive, elephant-like humanoids standing between 7 and 8 feet tall, with thick, leathery skin and a prehensile trunk.

Powerful Build.notes: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

Trunk.notes: You can grasp things with your trunk, and you can use it as a snorkel. It has a reach of 5 feet, and it can lift a number of pounds equal to five times your Strength score. You can use it to do the following simple tasks: lift, drop, hold, push, or pull an object or a creature; open or close a door or a container; grapple someone; or make an unarmed strike. Your DM might allow other simple tasks to be added to that list of options. Your trunk can't wield weapons or shields or do anything that requires manual precision, such as using tools or magic items or performing the somatic components of a spell.

Keen Smell.notes: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception), Wisdom (Survival), and Intelligence (Investigation) checks that involve smell.

name: Minotaur

traits.name: Horns
traits.description: Your horns are natural melee weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal piercing damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Goring Rush
traits.description: Immediately after you use the Dash action on your turn and move at least 20 feet, you can make one melee attack with your horns as a bonus action.

traits.name: Hammering Horns
traits.description: Immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to shove that target with your horns. The target must be no more than one size larger than you and within 5 feet of you. Unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw against a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier, you push it up to 10 feet away from you.

traits.name: Imposing Presence
traits.description: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Intimidation or Persuasion.

description: Minotaurs average over 6 feet in height, and they have stocky builds.

Horns.notes: Your horns are natural melee weapons. You can use them to make unarmed strikes that deal 1d6 + Strength modifier piercing damage instead of the normal bludgeoning damage.

Goring Rush.notes: Immediately after you use the Dash action and move at least 20 feet, you can make one melee attack with your horns as a bonus action.

Hammering Horns.notes: Immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack as part of the Attack action, you can use a bonus action to attempt to shove that target with your horns. The target must be no more than one size larger than you and within 5 feet. Unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier), you push it up to 10 feet away.

Imposing Presence.notes: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Intimidation or Persuasion.

name: Simic Hybrid
languages: Elvish (or another language of your choice)

traits.name: Animal Enhancements
traits.description:
Your body has been altered to incorporate certain animal characteristics. You choose one of the following options when you create your character, and you can't change it later. 

**Manta Glide.** You have gliding membranes like a manta ray. You have a flying speed of 30 feet when you aren't wearing heavy armor. This speed is reduced by 10 feet if you are carrying 100 pounds or more. 

**Nimble Climber.** You have a climbing speed of 30 feet. 

**Underwater Adaptation.** You have a swimming speed of 30 feet, and you can breathe underwater.

traits.name: Variable Adaptation
traits.description:
When you reach 5th level, you can choose one of the following options, which represents a further adaptation to your environment. You can't change this later. 

**Gills.** You can breathe underwater. 

**Grappling Appendage.** You have a special appendage that you can use to grapple creatures. It's a natural melee weapon with which you are proficient. If you hit a creature with it, the target takes bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier, and it is grappled (escape DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier). This appendage can't be used to make attacks against a creature you have grappled, but you can release it as a free action. 

**Reactive Carapace.** When you take damage, you can use your reaction to gain resistance to that damage. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

description: Simic Hybrids are humanoid soldiers created by the Simic Combine's Guardian Project, transformed from human, vedalken, and elf volunteers to defend the guild.

Animal Enhancements.notes: Choose one option at character creation: Manta Glide (flying speed 30 ft when not wearing heavy armor, reduced by 10 ft if carrying 100+ lbs), Nimble Climber (climbing speed 30 ft), or Underwater Adaptation (swimming speed 30 ft, can breathe underwater).

Variable Adaptation.notes: At 5th level, choose one: Gills (breathe underwater), Grappling Appendage (natural melee weapon, 1d6+Str bludgeoning, grapples on hit, escape DC 8+prof+Str), or Reactive Carapace (reaction to gain resistance to damage taken, recharges on short/long rest).

name: Vedalken
languages: one other language of your choice

traits.name: Vedalken Dispassion
traits.description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Tireless Precision
traits.description: You are proficient in one of the following skills of your choice: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Performance, or Sleight of Hand. You are also proficient with one tool of your choice. Whenever you make an ability check with the chosen skill or tool, roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the check's total.

traits.name: Partially Amphibious
traits.description: By absorbing oxygen through your skin, you can breathe underwater for up to 1 hour. Once you've reached that limit, you can't use this trait again until you finish a long rest.

description: Vedalken are tall and slender, standing almost a head taller than humans on average but weighing about the same. Their hairless skin comes in a range of shades of blue, their eyes are darker shades of blue or violet, they lack external ears, their noses are broad and flat, and they are partially amphibious.

Vedalken Dispassion.notes: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

skill_profs: one skill of your choice: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Performance, or Sleight of Hand
Tireless Precision.notes: Whenever you make an ability check with the chosen skill or tool, roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the check's total.

Partially Amphibious.notes: By absorbing oxygen through your skin, you can breathe underwater for up to 1 hour. Once you've reached that limit, you can't use this trait again until you finish a long rest.

name: Shadar-kai

traits.name: Necrotic Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage.

traits.name: Blessing of the Raven Queen
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Starting at 3rd level, you also gain resistance to all damage when you teleport using this trait. The resistance lasts until the start of your next turn. During that time, you appear ghostly and translucent.

description: Sworn to the Raven Queen's service, the mysterious shadar-kai venture into the Material Plane from the Shadowfell to advance her will. Once they were fey like the rest of their elven kin, and now they exist in a strange state between life and death.

Blessing of the Raven Queen.notes: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Starting at 3rd level, you also gain resistance to all damage when you teleport using this trait. The resistance lasts until the start of your next turn. During that time, you appear ghostly and translucent.

name: Duergar

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet.

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Undercommon.

traits.name: Duergar Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against illusions and against being charmed or paralyzed.

traits.name: Duergar Magic
traits.description: When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the enlarge/reduce spell on yourself once with this trait, using only the spell's enlarge option. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the invisibility spell on yourself once with this trait. You don't need material components for either spell, and you can't cast them while you're in direct sunlight, although sunlight has no effect on them once cast. You regain the ability to cast these spells with this trait when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

description: Duergar are gray-skinned dwarves of the Underdark, known for their grim resilience, psionic potential, and deep-seated hatred of their surface-dwelling kin.

Extra Language.notes: You can speak, read, and write Undercommon.

Duergar Resilience.notes: You have advantage on saving throws against illusions.

Duergar Magic.notes: At 3rd level, you can cast enlarge/reduce (enlarge only) on yourself once per long rest. At 5th level, you can cast invisibility on yourself once per long rest. No material components needed. Cannot cast in direct sunlight, but sunlight has no effect once cast. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability.

Sunlight Sensitivity.notes: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target, or the thing you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

name: Gith

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Intelligence score increases by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Gith reach adulthood in their late teens and live for about a century.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Gith are taller and leaner than humans, with most a slender 6 feet in height.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Gith.

traits.name: Subrace
traits.description: There are two kinds of gith, githyanki and githzerai. Choose one of these subraces.

subraces.name: Githyanki

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Strength score increases by 2.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Githyanki tend toward lawful evil. They are aggressive and arrogant, and they remain the faithful servants of their lich-queen, Vlaakith. Renegade githyanki tend toward chaos.

traits.name: Decadent Mastery
traits.description: You learn one language of your choice, and you are proficient with one skill or tool of your choice. In the timeless city of Tu'narath, githyanki have bountiful time to master odd bits of knowledge.

traits.name: Martial Prodigy
traits.description: You are proficient with light and medium armor and with shortswords, longswords, and greatswords.

traits.name: Githyanki Psionics
traits.description: You know the mage hand cantrip, and the hand is invisible when you cast the cantrip with this trait. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the jump spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the misty step spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells. When you cast them with this trait, they don't require components.

subraces.description: The brutal githyanki are trained from birth as warriors.

subraces.name: Githzerai

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Wisdom score increases by 2.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Githzerai tend toward lawful neutral. Their rigorous training in psychic abilities requires an implacable mental discipline.

traits.name: Mental Discipline
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against the charmed and frightened conditions. Under the tutelage of monastic masters, githzerai learn to govern their own minds.

traits.name: Githzerai Psionics
traits.description: You know the mage hand cantrip, and the hand is invisible when you cast the cantrip with this trait. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the shield spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the detect thoughts spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells. When you cast them with this trait, they don't require components.

subraces.description: In their fortresses within Limbo, the githzerai hone their minds to a razor's edge.

description: Gith are taller and leaner than humans, with most a slender 6 feet in height.

Age.notes: Gith reach adulthood in their late teens and live for about a century.

Size.notes: Gith are taller and leaner than humans, with most a slender 6 feet in height.

Languages.notes: Can speak, read, and write Common and Gith.

Subrace.notes: Choose between githyanki and githzerai subrace.

name: Wood Elf

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Fleet of Foot
traits.description: Your base walking speed increases to 35 feet.

traits.name: Mask of the Wild
traits.description: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

description: Wood elves are a reclusive and graceful race, known for their keen senses and affinity for nature.

Mask of the Wild.notes: Can attempt to hide when only lightly obscured by natural phenomena (foliage, rain, snow, mist, etc.).

name: Dark Elf (Drow)

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

traits.name: Drow Magic
traits.description: You know the dancing lights cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the faerie fire spell once per day. When you reach 5th level, you can also cast the darkness spell once per day. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Drow Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with rapiers, shortswords, and hand crossbows.

description: Dark elves, also called drow, have black skin that resembles polished obsidian and stark white or pale yellow hair, with very pale eyes in shades of lilac, silver, pink, red, and blue. They tend to be smaller and thinner than most elves.

Sunlight Sensitivity.notes: Disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when in direct sunlight.

Drow Magic.notes: Knows dancing lights cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast faerie fire once per day. At 5th level, can cast darkness once per day. Charisma is spellcasting ability.

name: Gold Dwarf

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Dwarven Combat Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer.

traits.name: Tool Proficiency
traits.description: You gain proficiency with the artisan's tools of your choice: smith's tools, brewer's supplies, or mason's tools.

subraces.name: Hill Dwarf

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

subraces.description: Gold dwarves have the racial traits of hill dwarves in the Player's Handbook.

description: Gold dwarves are stocky and muscular, averaging about 4 feet tall, with brown skin, black or brown hair, and brown or hazel eyes, with green eyes rare (and considered lucky). Males grow full beards that they keep oiled and well groomed, and both genders wear their hair long and often elaborately braided.

Dwarven Resilience.notes: Advantage on saving throws against poison.

Stonecunning.notes: Considered proficient in History checks related to stonework origin, and adds double proficiency bonus to such checks.

Tool Proficiency.notes: Choose one of the listed artisan's tools.

name: Gray Dwarf (Duergar)

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Dwarven Combat Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer.

traits.name: Tool Proficiency
traits.description: You gain proficiency with the artisan's tools of your choice: smith's tools, brewer's supplies, or mason's tools.

subraces.name: Duergar

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet.

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Undercommon.

traits.name: Duergar Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against illusions and against being charmed or paralyzed.

traits.name: Duergar Magic
traits.description: When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the enlarge/reduce spell on yourself once with this trait, using only the spell's enlarge option. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the invisibility spell on yourself once with this trait. You don't need material components for either spell, and you can't cast them while you're in direct sunlight, although sunlight has no effect on them once cast. You regain the ability to cast these spells with this trait when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.
