subraces.description: The gray dwarves, or duergar, live deep in the Underdark. They are wiry and lean, with black eyes and bald heads, with the males growing long, unkempt, gray beards.

description: Gray dwarves (duergar) are grim, ashen-skinned dwarves who live in the Underdark, valuing toil above all else and disdaining aesthetic or artistic value.

Dwarven Resilience.notes: Advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

Stonecunning.notes: When making an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient and add double your proficiency bonus.

Tool Proficiency.notes: You gain proficiency with one of the listed artisan's tools of your choice.

name: Strongheart Halfling

traits.name: Lucky
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

traits.name: Stout Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

description: Strongheart halflings are shorter on average than their lightfoot kin, and tend to have rounder faces. They have the skin tones and hair colors of humans, with most having brown hair.

Lucky.notes: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

Halfling Nimbleness.notes: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

Stout Resilience.notes: You have advantage on saving throws against poison.

name: Ghostwise Halflings

traits.name: Silent Speech
traits.description: You can speak telepathically to any creature within 30 feet of you. The creature understands you only if the two of you share a language. You can speak telepathically in this way to one creature at a time.

description: Ghostwise halflings are a reclusive and silent subrace of halflings, known for their telepathic communication and deep connection to nature.

Silent Speech.notes: You can speak telepathically to any creature within 30 feet of you. The creature understands you only if the two of you share a language. You can speak telepathically in this way to one creature at a time.

name: Lizardfolk

traits.name: Bite
traits.description: Your fanged maw is a natural weapon, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with it, you deal piercing damage equal to ld6 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Cunning Artisan
traits.description: As part of a short rest, you can harvest bone and hide from a slain beast, construct, dragon, monstrosity, or plant creature of size Small or larger to create one of the following items: a shield, a club, a javelin, or ld4 darts or blowgun needles. To use this trait, you need a blade, such as a dagger, or appropriate artisan's tools, such as leatherworker's tools.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes at a time.

traits.name: Hunter's Lore
traits.description: You gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Nature, Perception, Stealth, and Survival.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.description: You have tough, scaly skin. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

traits.name: Hungry Jaws
traits.description: In battle, you can throw yourself into a vicious feeding frenzy. As a bonus action, you can make a special attack with your bite. If the attack hits, it deals its normal damage, and you gain temporary hit points (minimum of 1) equal to your Constitution modifier, and you can't use this trait again until you finish a short or long rest.

description: Lizardfolk are a little bulkier and taller than humans, and their colorful frills make them appear even larger.

Bite.notes: Natural weapon: fanged maw (unarmed strike, 1d6 piercing damage + Strength modifier instead of normal bludgeoning).

Cunning Artisan.notes: During a short rest, can harvest bone/hide from a slain creature (size Small or larger, type beast/construct/dragon/monstrosity/plant) to create a shield, club, javelin, or 1d4 darts/blowgun needles. Requires a blade or appropriate artisan's tools.

Hold Breath.notes: Can hold breath for up to 15 minutes.

Hunter's Lore.notes: Choose two of the listed skills to gain proficiency in.

Natural Armor.notes: Natural armor (scaly skin). AC = 13 + Dexterity modifier when not wearing armor. Shield benefits apply normally.

Hungry Jaws.notes: Bonus action: special bite attack. If hits, deals normal bite damage and gain temporary HP equal to Constitution modifier (minimum 1). Cannot use again until after a short or long rest.

name: Triton

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Strength, Constitution, and Charisma scores each increase by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Tritons reach maturity around age 15 and can live up to 200 years.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Tritons tend toward lawful good. As guardians of the darkest reaches of the sea, their culture pushes them toward order and benevolence.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Tritons are slightly shorter than humans, averaging about 5 feet tall. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Control Air and Water
traits.description: A child of the sea, you can call on the magic of elemental air and water. You can cast fog cloud with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast gust of wind with it, and starting at 5th level, you can also cast wall of water with it (see the spell in the sidebar). Once you cast a spell with this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Emissary of the Sea
traits.description: Aquatic beasts have an extraordinary affinity with your people. You can communicate simple ideas with beasts that can breathe water. They can understand the meaning of your words, though you have no special ability to understand them in return.

traits.name: Guardians of the Depths
traits.description: Adapted to even the most extreme ocean depths, you have resistance to cold damage, and you ignore any of the drawbacks caused by a deep, underwater environment.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Primordial.

description: Tritons are slightly shorter than humans, averaging about 5 feet tall, and are guardians of the darkest reaches of the sea.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Strength, Constitution, and Charisma scores each increase by 1.

Age.notes: Tritons reach maturity around age 15 and can live up to 200 years.

Control Air and Water.notes: Can cast fog cloud (at will), gust of wind (3rd level), and wall of water (5th level) once per long rest. Charisma is spellcasting ability.

Emissary of the Sea.notes: Can communicate simple ideas with beasts that can breathe water.

Guardians of the Depths.notes: Ignores drawbacks caused by deep, underwater environments.

Languages.notes: Speaks, reads, and writes Common and Primordial.

name: Kobold

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Grovel, Cower, and Bes
traits.description: As an action on your tum, you can cower pathetically to distract nearby foes. Until the end of your next turn, your allies gain advantage on attack rolls against enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: You have advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

description: Kobolds are between 2 and 3 feet tall and weigh between 25 and 35 pounds. They are small, reptilian humanoids with a selfish and lawful evil alignment.

Grovel, Cower, and Bes.notes: As an action, you can cower pathetically to distract nearby foes. Until the end of your next turn, allies gain advantage on attack rolls against enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you. Once used, cannot be used again until after a short or long rest.

Pack Tactics.notes: You have advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one ally is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

Sunlight Sensitivity.notes: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

name: Yuan-ti Pureblood

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: You know the poison spray cantrip. You can cast animal friendship an unlimited number of times with this trait, but you can target only snakes with it. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast suggestion with this trait. Once you cast it, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Poison Immunity
traits.description: You are immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition.

description: Purebloods match humans in average size and weight. They are devoid of emotion and see others as tools to manipulate.

Innate Spellcasting.notes: Knows poison spray cantrip. Can cast animal friendship unlimited times (snakes only). At 3rd level, can cast suggestion once per long rest. Charisma is spellcasting ability.

Magic Resistance.notes: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

name: Grung

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The grung can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Poisonous Skin
traits.description: Any creature that grapples the grung or otherwise comes into direct contact with the grung's skin must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned creature no longer in direct contact with the grung can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: The grung's long jump is up to 25 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Water Dependency
traits.description: A grung that fails to immerse itself in water for at least 1 hour during a day suffers one level of exhaustion at the end of that day. A grung can recover from this exhaustion only through magic or by immersing itself in water for at least 1 hour.

description: Grungs are small, poisonous frog-like humanoids that live in hierarchical caste societies and are known for their toxic skin and ability to leap great distances.

Poisonous Skin.notes: Any creature that grapples the grung or otherwise comes into direct contact with the grung's skin must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned creature no longer in direct contact with the grung can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Standing Leap.notes: Long jump up to 25 feet, high jump up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

Water Dependency.notes: Must immerse in water for at least 1 hour per day or suffer one level of exhaustion at the end of that day. Exhaustion can only be recovered via magic or by immersing in water for at least 1 hour.

name: Tlincalli
description: Tlincallis, also called scorpion folk, are chitin-covered creatures, humanoid from the waist up with the lower body of an enormous scorpion, complete with a stinger at the end of a long tail.

name: Xvart

traits.name: Low Cunning
traits.description: The xvart can take the Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Overbearing Pack
traits.description: The xvart has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to shove a creature if at least one of the xvart's allies is within 5 feet of the target and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Raxivort's Tongue
traits.description: The xvart can communicate with ordinary bats and rats, as well as giant bats and giant rats.

description: Xvarts are small, chaotic evil humanoids with a greedy and cowardly nature, often found in the company of giant rats and bats.

Low Cunning.notes: Can take the Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

Overbearing Pack.notes: Has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to shove a creature if at least one ally is within 5 feet of the target and the ally isn't incapacitated.

Raxivort's Tongue.notes: Can communicate with ordinary bats and rats, as well as giant bats and giant rats.

name: Mark of Detection

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity and Charisma scores both increase by 1. In addition, one ability score of your choice increases by 1.

traits.name: Sea Monkey
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a swim speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Windwright's Intuition
traits.description: When you make a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or any ability check involving operating or maintaining a water or air vehicle, you can roll one Intuition die, a d4, and add the number rolled to the ability check.

traits.name: Storm's Blessing
traits.description: You have resistance to lightning damage.

traits.name: Headwinds
traits.description: You know the gust cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the gust of wind spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish.

description: The Mark of Detection manifests exclusively on half-elves. These traits replace the half-elf Ability Score Increase, Skill Versatility, and Languages traits given in the Player's Handbook.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Dexterity and Charisma increase by 1, and one other ability score of choice increases by 1.

Windwright's Intuition.notes: Can roll a d4 and add it to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks or ability checks involving operating/maintaining water or air vehicles.

Headwinds.notes: Knows the gust cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast gust of wind once per long rest.

Languages.notes: Can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish.

name: Mark of Finding (Human)

traits.name: Ability Score Increase (Human)
traits.description: As a human, your Dexterity and Wisdom scores both increase by 1. In addition, one ability score of your choice increases by 1.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Hunter's Intuition
traits.description: Your mark sharpens your senses and helps you find your prey. When you make a Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) check, you can roll one Intuition die, a d4, and add the number rolled to the ability check.

traits.name: Imprint Prey
traits.description:
As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target is imprinted in your mind until it dies or you use this trait again. Alternatively, you can imprint a creature as your quarry whenever you succeed on a Wisdom (Survival) check to track it.

When tracking your quarry, double the result of your Intuition die. When your quarry is within 60 feet of you, you have a sense of its location: it can't be hidden from you, gains no benefit from invisibility, and your attacks against it ignore half cover. Once you use this trait, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Nature's Voice
traits.description: When you reach 3rd level you gain the ability to cast locate animal or plant, but only as a ritual.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Goblin.

description: The Mark of Finding can appear on either humans or half-orcs. If your character has the Mark of Finding, these traits replace all racial traits given in the Player's Handbook aside from Age, Size, and Speed.

Ability Score Increase (Human).notes: Ability score increases: Dexterity +1, Wisdom +1, and one other ability score of choice +1.

Darkvision.notes: Can see in dim light as bright light and in darkness as dim light within 60 ft; no color discerned in darkness.

Hunter's Intuition.notes: When making a Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) check, roll a d4 (Intuition die) and add it to the check.

Imprint Prey.notes: Bonus action to imprint a creature within 30 ft (or via Survival check). While tracking quarry, double Intuition die result. Quarry within 60 ft cannot be hidden from you, gains no benefit from invisibility, and your attacks ignore half cover. Recharges on short or long rest.

Nature's Voice.notes: At 3rd level, can cast locate animals or plants as a ritual.

Languages.notes: Speaks, reads, and writes Common and Goblin.

name: Mark of Handling (Human)

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity and Wisdom scores both increase by 1. In addition, one ability score of your choice increases by 1.

traits.name: Wild Intuition
traits.description: When you make a Wisdom (Animal Handling) or Intelligence (Nature) check, you can roll one Intuition die, a d4, and add the number rolled to the ability check.

traits.name: Expert Handling
traits.description: You can use the Help action to aid an ally animal companion or mount within 30 feet of you, rather than 5 feet of you.

traits.name: Primal Connection
traits.description: You can cast animal Jriendship once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a short or long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

traits.name: The Bigger They Are
traits.description: When you cast a spell that affects only beasts, it also affects monstrosities with an Intelligence score of 3 or lower.

description: The Mark of Handling only manifests on humans. If your character has the Mark of Handing, these traits replace the human's Ability Score Increase trait given in the Player's Handbook.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Dexterity and Wisdom scores both increase by 1. In addition, one ability score of your choice increases by 1.

Wild Intuition.notes: When you make a Wisdom (Animal Handling) or Intelligence (Nature) check, you can roll one Intuition die, a d4, and add the number rolled to the ability check.

Expert Handling.notes: You can use the Help action to aid an ally animal companion or mount within 30 feet of you, rather than 5 feet of you.

Primal Connection.notes: You can cast animal friendship once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a short or long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

The Bigger They Are.notes: When you cast a spell that affects only beasts, it also affects monstrosities with an Intelligence score of 3 or lower.

name: Mark of Healing (Halfling)

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

traits.name: Medical Intuition
traits.description: When you make a Wisdom (Medicine) check, you can roll one Intuition die, a d4, and add the number rolled to the ability check.

traits.name: Healing Touch
traits.description: As an action, you can draw power from your dragonmark to spend one of your Hit Dice and revitalize yourself or a creature you touch. Roll the die, add your Wisdom modifier, and the creature regains a number of hit points equal to the total. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

description: The Mark of Healing manifests exclusively on halflings. If your character has the Mark of Healing, this is your halfling subrace.

Medical Intuition.notes: When making a Wisdom (Medicine) check, you can roll a d4 and add it to the check.

Healing Touch.notes: As an action, you can spend one Hit Die to heal yourself or a touched creature. Roll the die, add your Wisdom modifier, and the target regains that many hit points. Usable once per short or long rest.

name: Mark of Passage (Human)

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2 and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1.

traits.name: Courier's Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed increases to 40 ft.

traits.name: Intuitive Motion
traits.description: When you make a Strength (Athletics) check or any ability check to operate or maintain a land vehicle, you can roll one Intuition die, a d4, and add the number rolled to the ability check.

traits.name: Determined Stride
traits.description: When you use the Dash action, difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement on that turn.

traits.name: Shared Passage
traits.description: As a bonus action you can teleport a distance up to your walking speed, ending in an unoccupied space that you can see. You can bring one willing creature of your size or smaller who is carrying gear up to its carrying capacity. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you use this trait. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

description: The Mark of Passage governs motion, allowing its bearer to move with uncanny speed and precision. Running, leaping, climbing—the Mark of Passage enhances every form of movement.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Ability score increases are not a mechanical effect captured by these fields.

Intuitive Motion.notes: Adds a d4 (Intuition die) to Strength (Athletics) checks and ability checks to operate or maintain a land vehicle.

Determined Stride.notes: When using the Dash action, difficult terrain does not cost extra movement on that turn.

Shared Passage.notes: Bonus action teleport up to walking speed to an unoccupied space you can see, bringing one willing creature of your size or smaller within 5 ft. Usable once per long rest.

name: Mark of Scribing (Gnome)
languages: one extra language of your choice

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Gifted Scribe
traits.description: You are proficient with calligrapher's supplies and forgery kits. When you make an ability check using either one of these tools, you can roll one Intuition die, a d4, and add the number rolled to the ability check.

traits.name: Scribe's Insight
traits.description: You can cast comprehend languages once with this trait, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Whispering Wind
traits.description: You know the cantrip message. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability when casting it.

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

description: The Mark of Scribing deals with communication—both the written and spoken word. A gnome who bears the mark can feel words as though they are living creatures, struggling to make their meaning known.

Gifted Scribe.notes: When making an ability check with calligrapher's supplies or forgery kit, you can roll a d4 and add it to the check.

Scribe's Insight.notes: You can cast comprehend languages once per long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability.

Whispering Wind.notes: You know the cantrip message. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability.

Extra Language.notes: You can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

name: Mark of Sentinel

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Strength and Wisdom scores both increase by 1. In addition, one ability score of your choice increases by 1.

traits.name: Sentinel's Intuition
traits.description: When you roll for Initiative or make a Wisdom (Perception) check to notice a threat, you can roll one Intuition die, a d4, and add it to the ability check.

traits.name: Sentinel's Shield
traits.description: You know the cantrip blade ward. You can cast shield once with this trait and regain the ability to do so after you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Vigilant Guardian
traits.description:
As an action, you can designate an ally you can see as your ward.

You have advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Wisdom (Perception) checks made to spot threats to your ward. In addition, when you are within 5 feet of your ward, and that creature is the target of an attack that you can see, you can use your reaction to swap places with your ward. When you do, you become the target of the attack.

description: The Mark of Sentinel only manifests on humans. These traits replace the human Ability Score Increase trait given in the Player's Handbook.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Strength +1, Wisdom +1, and one other ability score +1.

Sentinel's Intuition.notes: When rolling Initiative or a Wisdom (Perception) check to notice a threat, you can roll a d4 and add it to the check.

Sentinel's Shield.notes: Knows the blade ward cantrip. Can cast shield once per short or long rest.

Vigilant Guardian.notes: As an action, designate an ally as ward. Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Wisdom (Perception) to spot threats to ward. When within 5 ft of ward and ward is attacked, can use reaction to swap places and become target.

name: Mark of Shadow

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Natural Talent
traits.description: You gain proficiency with one musical instrument or the Performance skill.

traits.name: Gift of the Shadows
traits.description: When you make a Charisma (Performance) or Dexterity (Stealth) check, you can roll one Intuition die, a d4, and add the number rolled to the ability check.

traits.name: Shape Shadows
traits.description: You know the minor illusion cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this trait.

traits.name: Slip Into Shadow
traits.description: You can use the Hide action as a bonus action, even if you have no cover or if you're under observation. Regardless of whether you succeed or fail, once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

description: The Mark of Shadow only manifests on elves, granting them shadowy abilities and a connection to illusion and stealth.

Natural Talent.notes: Choose either one musical instrument proficiency or the Performance skill.

Gift of the Shadows.notes: When making a Charisma (Performance) or Dexterity (Stealth) check, you can roll a d4 and add it to the check.

Shape Shadows.notes: You know the minor illusion cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

Slip Into Shadow.notes: You can use the Hide action as a bonus action even without cover or while observed. Once used, cannot use again until short or long rest.

name: Mark of Storm (Half-Elf)

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity and Charisma scores both increase by 1. In addition, one ability score of your choice increases by 1.

traits.name: Sea Monkey
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a swim speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Windwright's Intuition
traits.description: When you make a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or any ability check involving operating or maintaining a water or air vehicle, you can roll one Intuition die, a d4, and add the number rolled to the ability check.

traits.name: Storm's Blessing
traits.description: You have resistance to lightning damage.

traits.name: Headwinds
traits.description: You know the gust cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the gust of wind spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

description: The Mark of Storm manifests exclusively on half-elves, granting them control over wind and weather.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Dexterity and Charisma increase by 1, and one other ability score of choice increases by 1.

Sea Monkey.notes: Has a swim speed of 30 feet.

Windwright's Intuition.notes: When making a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or any ability check involving operating/maintaining a water or air vehicle, roll a d4 and add it to the check.

Headwinds.notes: Knows the gust cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast gust of wind once per long rest.

name: Mark of Warding (Dwarf)

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity and Intelligence scores increase by 1.

traits.name: Master of Locks
traits.description: When you make an Intelligence (History), Intelligence (Investigation), or Thieves' Tools check involving lock and trap mechanisms, you can roll one Intuition die, a d4, and add the number rolled to the ability check.

traits.name: Wards and Seals
traits.description: You can use your mark to cast the alarm spell as a ritual. Starting at 3rd level you can cast arcane lock once with this trait and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: The Mark of Warding manifests exclusively on dwarves, granting them protective and sealing magic.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Dexterity and Intelligence scores increase by 1.

Master of Locks.notes: When making Intelligence (History), Intelligence (Investigation), or Thieves' Tools checks involving lock and trap mechanisms, roll a d4 and add it to the check.

Wards and Seals.notes: Can cast alarm as a ritual. At 3rd level, can cast arcane lock once per long rest. Intelligence is spellcasting ability.

name: Ratfolk

traits.name: Nimbleness
traits.description: The ratfolk can move through the space of any Medium or larger creature.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The ratfolk has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the ratfolk's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Swim Speed
traits.description: The ratfolk has a swimming speed of 10 feet.

description: Ratfolk are small humanoids with a knack for stealth and pack tactics, often found in mercenary or warlock roles. They have darkvision and a natural nimbleness that allows them to move through larger creatures' spaces.

Nimbleness.notes: Can move through the space of any Medium or larger creature.

Pack Tactics.notes: Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one ally is within 5 feet and not incapacitated.

name: Alseid

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Alseid Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with spears and shortbows.

traits.name: Light Hooves
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Stealth skill.

traits.name: Quadruped
traits.description: The mundane details of the structures of humanoids can present considerable obstacles for you. You have to squeeze when moving through trapdoors, manholes, and similar structures even when a Medium humanoid wouldn't have to squeeze. In addition, ladders, stairs, and similar structures are difficult terrain for you.

traits.name: Woodfriend
traits.description: When in a forest, you leave no tracks and can automatically discern true north.

description: Alseid are tall, antlered humanoids standing over 6 feet tall and weighing around 300 pounds, with a deep connection to the Old World magic of the Margreve forest.

name: Bearfolk

traits.name: Bite
traits.description: Your powerful jaws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If it hits, you deal 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.description: Your hide is thick and tough, granting you a natural AC of 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Ursine Talent
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Athletics and Perception skills.

description: Bearfolk can reach a height of over 7 feet, possessing thick, muscular builds.

name: Beorning

traits.name: Angry
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

traits.name: Starting Virtue
traits.description: You gain one Beorning Cultural Virtue of your choice.

description: Most Beornings are fairly stocky and often stand 6 feet tall or more. They are a hardy folk who sustain themselves by breeding cattle and horses and keeping hives of great bees.

name: Darakhul

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as though it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Hunger for Flesh
traits.description: You must consume 1 pound of raw meat each day or suffer the effects of starvation. If you go 24 hours without such a meal, you gain one level of exhaustion. While you have any levels of exhaustion from this trait, you can't regain hit points or remove levels of exhaustion until you spend at least 1 hour consuming 10 pounds of raw meat.

traits.name: Imperfect Undeath
traits.description: You transitioned into undeath, but your transition was imperfect. Though you are a humanoid, you are susceptible to effects that target undead. You can regain hit points from spells like cure wounds, but you can also be affected by game effects that specifically target undead, such as a cleric's Turn Undead feature. Game effects that raise a creature from the dead work on you as normal, but they return you to life as a darakhul. A true resurrection or wish spell can restore you to life as a fully living member of your original race.

traits.name: Powerful Jaw
traits.description: Your heavy jaw is powerful enough to crush bones to powder. Your bite is a natural melee weapon, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with it, your bite deals piercing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

traits.name: Undead Resilience
traits.description: You are infused with the dark energy of undeath, which frees you from some frailties that plague most creatures. You have resistance to necrotic damage and poison damage, you are immune to disease, and you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or poisoned. When you finish a short rest, you can reduce your exhaustion level by 1, provided you have ingested at least 1 pound of raw meat in the last 24 hours (see Hunger for Flesh feature).

traits.name: Undead Vitality
traits.description: You don't need to breathe, and you don't sleep the way most creatures do. Instead, you enter a dormant state that resembles death, remaining semiconscious, for 6 hours a day. While dormant, you have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.

description: Darakhul are undead creatures transformed from various mortal races, retaining some traits of their former lives while gaining necrotic powers.

name: Dúnedain

traits.name: Lore of Númenor
traits.description: You have proficiency in the History skill.

traits.name: Raised in the Wild
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Survival skill.

traits.name: Starting Virtue
traits.description: You gain one Dúnedain Cultural Virtue of your choice.

description: Most Dúnedain stand well over 6 feet tall. They never wear or carry anything whose worth cannot be measured in a practical way, and their gear is chosen for capability to endure long journeys and strenuous fights.

name: Erina

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as though it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Digger
traits.description: You have a burrow speed of 20 feet, but you can use it to only move through earth and sand, not mud, ice, or rock.

traits.name: Quills
traits.description: Your spines are longer and more potent than other erinas. Whenever you make a successful melee attack against a target within 5 feet of you, that target takes an additional 3 (1d6) piercing damage. (Replaces the base erina's Spines trait.)

traits.name: Sharp Instincts
traits.description: You can't be surprised, except when incapacitated by something other than nonmagical sleep. (Replaces the base erina's Keen Senses trait.)

traits.name: Spirit Tongue
traits.description: You have an innate knack for speaking to the spirit world. You know the message cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the charm person spell with this trait (targeting only undead creatures), and starting at 5th level, you can cast the enthrall spell with it. Once you cast a non-cantrip spell with this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: The erina are a race of bipedal folk that resemble hedgehogs. Spiritfarer erinas are a subrace of erina, whose ancestors were forever changed by the Shadow Realm, setting them apart from most other erina.

name: Piney

traits.name: Margreve Within
traits.description: As a piney adventuring beyond the Margreve, you have lost the more extreme, occasionally monstrous, qualities of your forest-dwelling kin. Nonetheless, the magic of the elder forest marks you. You can meet your daily alimentary needs by consuming a suitable amount of food or by standing in direct sunlight for 30 minutes. In addition, your organs are partially made from plant matter. You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

traits.name: Margreve Without
traits.description: Regardless of the time and distance between you and the Margreve, the forest's influence on you manifests in the form of strange alterations to your body. Although you are humanoid, your connection to the Margreve marks you with plant-like characteristics. Create a growth of your own in consultation with your GM or pick one from the following list: Your skin is rough with harmless cracks resembling tree bark; Heavily-perfumed flowers grow wherever your body hair is dense; Your eyes are twice as large as a human's, and their color is a changing swirl of green and brown; Your finger and toe nails are wood; Your major joints (shoulder, hip, knee) creak like tree branches when you move.

traits.name: Roots
traits.description: You have a deep and pragmatic connection with the natural world. You are proficient in the Nature and Survival skills.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: A life lived under the canopy of the forest has provided you with the ability to see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

description: Pineys are humanoid beings with plant-like characteristics, such as bark-like skin, wooden nails, or flowers growing from their bodies, and they vary widely in height and build from barely 5 feet to well over 6 feet tall.

name: Quickstep

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as though it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Nimble
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Acrobatics and Sleight of Hand skills.

traits.name: Startling Speed
traits.description: Your movements are so swift that you are almost invisible when in motion. If you move at least 10 feet on your turn, attack rolls against you have disadvantage until the start of your next turn. This feature does not function if you are incapacitated or restrained. You can use this ability a number of rounds per day equal to your level.

description: Quicksteps are small fey with a natural affinity for speed, often found in the fey courts, where they excel at sabotage and dueling. They have a fondness for finery and feel at home amid the riches of court life.

name: Ratatosk

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Grounded Celestial
traits.description: You are descended from celestials, but you are strongly attuned to the mortal world. Though you are a humanoid, you are still susceptible to effects that target celestials.

traits.name: Sharp Tusks
traits.description: Your sharp tusks are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal 1 piercing damage plus 1d4 psychic damage.

traits.name: Telepathic
traits.description: You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see, provided the creature is within a number of feet of you equal to 10 times your level. You don't need to share a language with the creature for it to understand your telepathic utterances, but the creature must be able to understand at least one language.

description: Resembling squirrels with sleek fur and small tusks, ratatosks are insatiable tricksters who form close matriarchal familial units called drays within larger communities called scurries.

name: Stygian Shade

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as though it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Death Mask
traits.description: As an action, you can strip away your veneer of life and expose your true spectral face. All non-undead creatures within 30 feet that can see you must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to your Death Mask for the next 24 hours. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Constitution modifier. (This trait replaces the base shade's Life Drain trait.)

traits.name: Ghostly Flesh
traits.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to dissolve your physical body into the ephemeral stuff of spirits. You become translucent and devoid of color, and the air around you grows cold. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. During it, you have a flying speed of 30 feet with the ability to hover, and you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks that aren't made with silvered weapons. In addition, you have advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple or against being restrained, and you can move through creatures and solid objects as if they were difficult terrain. If you end your turn inside an object, you take 1d10 force damage. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Imperfect Undeath
traits.description: You are a humanoid, but your partial transition into undeath makes you susceptible to effects that target undead. Though you can regain hit points from spells like cure wounds, you can also be affected by effects that specifically target undead, such as a cleric's Turn Undead feature. Effects that raise a creature from the dead work on you as normal, but they return you to life as a shade. A true resurrection or wish spell can restore you to life as a fully living member of your original race.

traits.name: Mysterious Origin
traits.description: Stygian shades are born with almost no memory of their former lives but have an innate desire to remember who they are. When you create your stygian shade, decide which one of these questions you know the answer to. The rest are questions you seek to answer: What is your name? Where are you from? Who were the people you loved most? How did you die? What unfinished business has caused you to rise as a shade? (This replaces the base shade's Living Origin trait.)

traits.name: Spectral Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison and disease, and you have resistance to necrotic damage.

description: Stygian shades are shades from the Shadow Realm who lack most of their memories and are driven to find what was lost. They appear as ghosts, often congregating in the city of Soriglass.

name: Sublime Ravenfolk

traits.name: Constant Tune
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. (This trait replaces the base ravenfolk's Sudden Attack trait.)

traits.name: Cosmic Musician
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Performance skill and gain proficiency with one musical instrument of your choice. (This trait replaces the base ravenfolk's Trickster trait.)

traits.name: Sublime Chord
traits.description: As an action, you can mimic the mysterious sublime song to charm creatures within range. All creatures within 30 feet that can hear you must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or become charmed by you for 10 minutes. The charmed creatures regard you as a casual friend. A creature makes this saving throw with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. Once you use this ability, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest. (This replaces the base ravenfolk's Mimicry trait.)

description: Sublime ravenfolk are a subrace of ravenfolk, drawn by a mysterious psychic song to the Shadow Realm, and are slighter and shorter than humans, ranging from 4 feet to just shy of 6 feet tall.

name: Unbound Satarre

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Thanks to your dark planar parentage, you have superior vision in darkness. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Keeper of Secrets
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Arcana skill, and you have advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks related to the planes and planar travel. In addition, you have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: History, Insight, or Religion.

traits.name: Portal Sense
traits.description: While in a confined space, you instinctively know the direction and distance to the closest nonmagical entrance or exit to the area you are currently in. You also have advantage on any Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Perception) ability checks made to find secret or invisible doors and magical portals. (This trait replaces the base satarre's A Friend of Death trait.)

traits.name: Unraveling Touch
traits.description: You can use your action to attempt to tear at the reality that keeps a being together. Choose a creature that you can see within 30 feet. The creature must make a Constitution saving throw. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A creature that fails the saving throw must use its action each turn to repeat the saving throw as it attempts to keep itself in one piece. On a successful save, the effect ends on the target. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest. (This trait replaces the base satarre's Carrier of Rot trait.)

description: Unbound satarre are a subrace of satarre, planar travelers with an instinctual sensitivity to places of transition, compelled to find gateways and widen their influence through mundane or magical means.

name: Thri-kreen

traits.name: Chameleon Carapace
traits.description: The thri-kreen can change the color of its carapace to match the color and texture of its surroundings. As a result, it has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

description: Thri-kreen are medium humanoid insectoids with a chitinous carapace, capable of changing color to blend with their surroundings, and possess powerful leaping abilities.

name: Dark Folk

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.description: The dark folk have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Gaze of Shadows
traits.description: The dark folk can trace the magical signature of any creature or object they can see that has cast or been affected by a spell within the last minute.

traits.name: Darksight
traits.description: Dark folk can see in dim light as though it were bright light, and in magical darkness as though it were dim light.

description: This pale-skinned humanoid is swathed in dark robes. Beneath its hood, its face is a grotesque mask. Smooth, featureless flesh is where one eye would be; the existing eye is a black pit that swallows both light and hope.

name: Kapi

traits.name: Nimble Feet
traits.description: The kapi can take the Disengage action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Prehensile Tail
traits.description: The kapi can use its tail to pick up and manipulate small objects.

description: Kapi are medium humanoid simians from tropical jungles, where they make their homes in treetop villages. They are curious, playful tricksters with prehensile tails.

name: Vanara

traits.name: Distract
traits.description: The vanara can use a bonus action to distract a creature within 5 feet, giving allies advantage on their next attack roll against that target.

traits.name: Quadrupedal Dash
traits.description: The vanara can use a bonus action to move on its hands and feet, increasing its speed by 10 feet for the turn.

description: Vanaras are a contemplative race that dwells in forests or along coastlines, living in tribes or clans. They are medium humanoids with simian features, often dressing only in short pants or waist wraps and a turban.

name: Molefolk

traits.name: Burrow
traits.description: The molefolk has a burrowing speed of 20 feet through dirt and loose earth.

description: This small, black-furred humanoid has oversized clawed hands, clamped together in a nervous gesture. His tiny eyes stare at you from behind a pair of thick spectacles positioned on his long pink nose.

name: Fairy
source: (D&D 5E Mordenkainen Presents Monsters of the Multiverse, p.14)

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Fey.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Small.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Fairy Magic
traits.description: You know the druidcraft cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the faerie fire spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the enlarge/reduce spell with this trait. Once you cast faerie fire or enlarge/reduce with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

traits.name: Flight
traits.description: Because of your wings, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can't use this flying speed if you're wearing medium or heavy armor.

description: Infused with the magic of the Feywild, most fairies look like Small elves with insectile wings, but each fairy has a special physical characteristic that sets the fairy apart.

Fairy Magic.notes: Knows druidcraft cantrip. At 3rd level can cast faerie fire once per long rest. At 5th level can also cast enlarge/reduce once per long rest. Can also cast these spells using spell slots. Spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when selecting race).

Flight.notes: Flying speed equal to walking speed. Cannot use flying speed while wearing medium or heavy armor.

name: Air Genasi
source: (D&D 5E Mordenkainen Presents Monsters of the Multiverse, p.16)

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 35 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Unending Breath
traits.description: You can hold your breath indefinitely while you're not incapacitated.

traits.name: Lightning Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to lightning damage.

traits.name: Mingle with the Wind
traits.description: You know the shocking grasp cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the feather fall spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the levitate spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast feather fall or levitate with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

description: Air genasi are descended from djinn, the genies of the Elemental Plane of Air. Their skin tones include many shades of blue, along with the full range of human skin tones, with bluish or ashen casts, and their hair might blow in a phantom wind or be made entirely of clouds or vapor.

Size.notes: Size is Medium or Small (chosen when selecting the race).

Unending Breath.notes: Can hold breath indefinitely while not incapacitated.

Mingle with the Wind.notes: Knows shocking grasp cantrip. At 3rd level can cast feather fall once per long rest without material components. At 5th level can also cast levitate once per long rest without material components. Can also cast these spells using spell slots. Spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when selecting the race).

name: Earth Genasi
source: (D&D 5E Mordenkainen Presents Monsters of the Multiverse, p.17)

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Earth Walk
traits.description: You can move across difficult terrain without expending extra movement if you are using your walking speed on the ground or a floor.

traits.name: Merge with Stone
traits.description: You know the blade ward cantrip. You can cast it as normal, and you can also cast it as a bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Starting at 5th level, you can cast the pass without trace spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast that spell with this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of 2nd level or higher. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

description: An earth genasi’s skin can be the colors of stone and earth or a human skin tone with glittering sparkles like gem dust. Some earth genasi have lines marking their skin like cracks, either showing glimmering gemlike veins or a dim, yellowish glow.

Size.notes: Size is Medium or Small (chosen when selecting the race).

Darkvision.notes: In darkness, vision is only in shades of gray.

Earth Walk.notes: Can move across difficult terrain without expending extra movement when using walking speed on the ground or a floor.

Merge with Stone.notes: Knows the blade ward cantrip; can cast it as a bonus action a number of times equal to proficiency bonus (regained on long rest). At 5th level, can cast pass without trace without material components once per long rest (also castable with 2nd-level+ spell slots). Spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when selecting the race).

name: Githyanki
source: (D&D 5E Mordenkainen Presents Monsters of the Multiverse, p.18)

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Astral Knowledge
traits.description: You can mystically access a reservoir of experiences of entities connected to the Astral Plane. Whenever you finish a long rest, you gain proficiency in one skill of your choice and with one weapon or tool of your choice, selected from the Player's Handbook, as you momentarily project your consciousness into the Astral Plane. These proficiencies last until the end of your next long rest.

traits.name: Githyanki Psionics
traits.description: You know the mage hand cantrip, and the hand is invisible when you cast the cantrip with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the jump spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the misty step spell with it. Once you cast jump or misty step with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race). None of these spells require spell components when you cast them with this trait.

traits.name: Psychic Resilience
traits.description: You have resistance to psychic damage.

description: A lanky people with skin tones of yellows, greens, and browns, githyanki complement their physical prowess with psionic might, instilled in them by mind flayers and cultivated over eons in the Astral Plane.

Astral Knowledge.notes: After each long rest, gain proficiency in one skill of your choice and with one weapon or tool of your choice from the Player's Handbook. These proficiencies last until the end of your next long rest.

Githyanki Psionics.notes: Know mage hand cantrip (hand invisible when cast with this trait). At 3rd level, can cast jump once per long rest. At 5th level, can cast misty step once per long rest. Can also cast jump or misty step using spell slots. Spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen at race selection). These spells require no components when cast with this trait.

name: Githzerai
source: (D&D 5E Mordenkainen Presents Monsters of the Multiverse, p.18)

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Githzerai Psionics
traits.description: You know the mage hand cantrip, and the hand is invisible when you cast the cantrip with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the shield spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the detect thoughts spell with it. Once you cast shield or detect thoughts with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race). None of these spells require spell components when you cast them with this trait.

traits.name: Mental Discipline
traits.description: Your innate psychic defenses grant you advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed and frightened conditions on yourself.

traits.name: Psychic Resilience
traits.description: You have resistance to psychic damage.

description: Githzerai are generally slender, with speckled skin in shades of yellow, green, or brown. Eons of cultivating their mental powers within the endless chaos of Limbo have imbued githzerai with the ability to shape psionic energy to protect themselves and probe minds.

Githzerai Psionics.notes: Knows mage hand cantrip (invisible hand when cast via this trait). At 3rd level can cast shield once per long rest. At 5th level can cast detect thoughts once per long rest. Can also cast these spells using spell slots. Spellcasting ability is Int, Wis, or Cha (chosen at race selection). Spells cast via this trait require no spell components.

Mental Discipline.notes: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the charmed and frightened conditions on yourself.

name: Harengon
source: (D&D 5E Mordenkainen Presents Monsters of the Multiverse, p.22)

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Hare-Trigger
traits.description: You can add your proficiency bonus to your initiative rolls.

traits.name: Leporine Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Lucky Footwork
traits.description: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your reaction to roll a d4 and add it to the save, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can't use this reaction if you're prone or your speed is 0.

traits.name: Rabbit Hop
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can jump a number of feet equal to five times your proficiency bonus, without provoking opportunity attacks. You can use this trait only if your speed is greater than 0. You can use it a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

description: Harengons are bipedal rabbitfolk with long feet, fur in a variety of colors, keen senses, powerful legs, and a bit of fey luck.

Size.notes: Size is Medium or Small (chosen when selecting the race).

Hare-Trigger.notes: Add proficiency bonus to initiative rolls.

Lucky Footwork.notes: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your reaction to roll a d4 and add it to the save, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can't use this reaction if you're prone or your speed is 0.

Rabbit Hop.notes: As a bonus action, you can jump a number of feet equal to five times your proficiency bonus, without provoking opportunity attacks. You can use this trait only if your speed is greater than 0. You can use it a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Satyr
source: (D&D 5E Mordenkainen Presents Monsters of the Multiverse, p.29)

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Fey.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 35 feet.

traits.name: Ram
traits.description: You can use your head and horns to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against spells.

traits.name: Mirthful Leaps
traits.description: Whenever you make a long jump or a high jump, you can roll a d8 and add the number rolled to the number of feet you cover, even when making a standing jump. This extra distance costs movement as normal.

traits.name: Reveler
traits.description: As an embodiment of revelry, you have proficiency in the Performance and Persuasion skills, and you have proficiency with one musical instrument of your choice.

description: Originating in the Feywild—a realm of pure emotion-satyrs thrive on the energy of merriment. They resemble elves but have goatlike legs, cloven hooves, and ram or goat horns.

Ram.notes: Natural weapon: unarmed strike with head/horns deals 1d6 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage.

Magic Resistance.notes: Advantage on saving throws against spells.

Mirthful Leaps.notes: When making a long or high jump, add 1d8 feet to distance covered, including standing jumps; extra distance costs movement as normal.

tool_profs: One musical instrument of your choice

name: Yuan-ti
source: (D&D 5E Mordenkainen Presents Monsters of the Multiverse, p.36)

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against spells.

traits.name: Poison Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the poisoned condition on yourself. You also have resistance to poison damage.

traits.name: Serpentine Spellcasting
traits.description: You know the poison spray cantrip. You can cast animal friendship an unlimited number of times with this trait, but you can target only snakes with it. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast suggestion with this trait. Once you cast it, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of 2nd level or higher. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

description: Yuan-ti were originally humans who transformed themselves into serpent folk through ancient rituals. Most yuan-ti were corrupted into monsters by those rites, but some yuan-ti instead became a new people who mix characteristics of humans and snakes.

Size.notes: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

Magic Resistance.notes: You have advantage on saving throws against spells.

Poison Resilience.notes: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the poisoned condition on yourself.

Serpentine Spellcasting.notes: You know the poison spray cantrip. You can cast animal friendship an unlimited number of times with this trait, but you can target only snakes with it. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast suggestion with this trait. Once you cast it, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of 2nd level or higher. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

name: Elf (High Elf)

traits.name: Cantrip
traits.description: You know one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

description: High elves are pale-skinned with alabaster skin sometimes tinged with blue, often having hair of silver-white, black, or blue, and eyes of blue or green flecked with gold.

Cantrip.notes: Knows one wizard cantrip of choice; Intelligence is the spellcasting ability for it.

Extra Language.notes: Can speak, read, and write one extra language of choice.

name: Halfling (Stout Subrace)

traits.name: Stout Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

subraces.name: Stout

traits.name: Stout Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

subraces.description: You're hardier than average and have some resistance to poison. Some say that stouts have dwarven blood. In the Forgotten Realms, these halflings are called stronghearts, and they're most common in the south.

description: Halflings are a small race known for their hardiness and resistance to poison, with the stout subrace being particularly resilient.

Stout Resilience.notes: Advantage on saving throws against poison.

name: Tiefling (Baalzebul)

traits.name: Legacy of Maladomini
traits.description: You know the thaumaturgy cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the ray of sickness spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the crown of madness spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: Tieflings linked to Baalzebul can corrupt others both physically and psychically.

Legacy of Maladomini.notes: Grants the thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast ray of sickness as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest. At 5th level, can cast crown of madness once per long rest. Charisma is the spellcasting ability for these spells.

name: Fierna Tiefling

traits.name: Legacy of Phlegethos
traits.description: You know the friends cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the charm person spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the suggestion spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: A master manipulator, Fierna grants tieflings tied to her forceful personalities.

Legacy of Phlegethos.notes: Grants the friends cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast charm person as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest. At 5th level, can cast suggestion once per long rest. Charisma is the spellcasting ability for these spells.

name: Glasya Tiefling

traits.name: Legacy of Malbolge
traits.description: You know the minor illusion cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the disguise self spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the invisibility spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: Glasya, Hell's criminal mastermind, grants her tieflings magic that is useful for committing heists.

Legacy of Malbolge.notes: Grants the minor illusion cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast disguise self once per long rest. At 5th level, can cast invisibility once per long rest. Charisma is the spellcasting ability for these spells.

name: Levistus Tiefling

traits.name: Legacy of Stygia
traits.description: You know the ray of frost cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the armor of Agathys spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the darkness spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: Frozen Stygia is ruled by Levistus, an archdevil known for offering bargains to those who face an inescapable doom.

Legacy of Stygia.notes: Grants the ray of frost cantrip (Charisma-based). At 3rd level, can cast armor of Agathys as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest. At 5th level, can cast darkness once per long rest. Charisma is the spellcasting ability for these spells.

name: Mammon Tiefling

traits.name: Legacy of Minauros
traits.description: You know the mage hand cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the Tenser's floating disk spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a short or long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the arcane lock spell once with this trait, requiring no material component, and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: The great miser Mammon loves coins above all else. Tieflings tied to him excel at gathering and safeguarding wealth.

Legacy of Minauros.notes: Grants the mage hand cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast Tenser's floating disk once per short or long rest. At 5th level, can cast arcane lock once per long rest without material components. Charisma is the spellcasting ability for these spells.

name: Mephistopheles Tiefling

traits.name: Legacy of Cania
traits.description: You know the mage hand cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the burning hands spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the flame blade spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: In the frozen realm of Cania, Mephistopheles offers arcane power to those who entreat with him. Tieflings linked to him master some arcane magic.

Legacy of Cania.notes: Grants the mage hand cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast burning hands as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest. At 5th level, can cast flame blade once per long rest. Charisma is the spellcasting ability for these spells.

name: Zariel Tiefling

traits.name: Legacy of Avernus
traits.description: You know the thaumaturgy cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the searing smite spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the branding smite spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: Tieflings with a blood tie to Zariel are stronger than the typical tiefling and receive magical abilities that aid them in battle.

Legacy of Avernus.notes: Grants the thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast searing smite as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest. At 5th level, can cast branding smite once per long rest. Charisma is the spellcasting ability for these spells.

name: Svirfneblin (Deep Gnome)

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet.

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.description: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain and underground.

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Undercommon.

description: Svirfneblin, or deep gnomes, are a subrace of gnomes adapted to life in the Underdark. They tend to weigh 80 to 120 pounds, mature at the same rate as humans, and live 200 to 250 years. They favor neutral alignments and believe survival depends on avoiding entanglements with other creatures.

Stone Camouflage.notes: Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain and underground.

Extra Language.notes: Can speak, read, and write Undercommon.

name: Shield Dwarf

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

traits.name: Dwarven Combat Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer.

traits.name: Tool Proficiency
traits.description: You gain proficiency with the artisan's tools of your choice: smith's tools, brewer's supplies, or mason's tools.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Dwarven Armor Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with light and medium armor.

description: Shield dwarves are a sturdy and reclusive folk, known for their settlements in mountainous regions and their resilience in harsh environments.

Dwarven Resilience.notes: Advantage on saving throws against poison (not full condition immunity)

Stonecunning.notes: Treated as proficient in History for stonework-related checks, with doubled proficiency bonus

name: Moon Elf

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day. (The Common word for such meditation is "trance.") traits.name: Extra Language
